images.prompt: Camera and composition: wide shot of a whole room or place like a miniature diorama, one or two small people doing the key action of the topic. Keep the top fifth of the image as softly blurred or plain background (a title band goes there). A wide view of a bright apartment living room like a miniature diorama, a Korean couple in their 30s, the husband in an olive shirt and the wife in a cream knit, sit small on a sofa looking at a blank bankbook and a few papers together, nodding, plants and a window around them. Expression: nodding with a reassuring smile, hands relaxed. Color theme: olive green and warm cream tones with a coral accent. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded chunky shapes, handmade plasticine texture, gentle studio lighting, miniature diorama feel, richer and more saturated colors than pastel, clear contrast, cozy and warm mood. Base colors cream, apricot, mint, sky blue and warm brown, a little deeper than pastel. Add one bright accent color (coral-red, mustard yellow or cobalt blue) on the main person's clothing or the key object. Korean people and Korean everyday settings. Show only what the image's own scene describes; do not repeat the post's main object in every image. Topic-specific details (medical, tools, places) are welcome where the scene calls for them. Everyone looks calm and relaxed — smiling, or thoughtful and curious; nobody is in pain, sad or scared. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, posters, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere.
